data: What is the maximum value of the red dashed line in the plot labeled "Year-wise Average Speed of Songs"?

The question asks for the maximum value of the red dashed line in the plot labeled "Year-wise Average Speed of Songs". The red dashed line represents the average speed of songs over the years. From the figure, we can see that the red dashed line reaches its peak at approximately 1.0 on the y-axis. Therefore, the maximum value of the red dashed line is around 1.0.
